fusions.name: Poleaxe Drop
fusions.desc: Brings the hammer face down for 32 blunt damage that ignores the target's armour, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Levelling Pound
fusions.desc: Pounds the butt into the ground, dealing 11 blunt damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Haft Turned Cudgel
fusions.desc: Increases your blunt damage by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Driven Flat
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: a blow strikes it for 30% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 5 seconds.
